Énoncé en bref

Déchiffrer le message en séparant ses symboles, en les convertissant en lettres et en remettant les caractères dans l’ordre.

Code Python

decode =lambda m:''.join([{"":'',"__":' ',"/\\":'a',"]3":'b',"(":'c',"|)":'d',"[-":'e',"/=":'f',"(_,":'g',
"|-|":'h',"|":'i',"_T":'j',"/<":'k',"|_":'l',"|\\/|":'m',"|\\|":'n',"()":'o',"|^":'p',"()_":'q',"/?":'r',
"_\\~":'s',"~|~":'t',"|_|":'u',"\\/":'v',"\\/\\/":'w',"><":'x',"`/":'y',"~/_":'z'}[c]for c in m.split(m[0])][::-1])

Exemple d’exécution

print(decode("#|#|-|"))
